## Imports (fixed interfaces, written concurrently)

```js

```

- null → `null`; true/false → `true`/`false`; int → decimal digits (BigInt → `.toString()`, no `n` suffix); float → `reprFloat(value)`; timestamp → its `text`.

Compute on the string `s`:
- `empty` = s is `''`
- `special` = any char outside `[0x20-0x7E]` except `\n` (so `\t`, `\r`, control chars, ALL non-ASCII — allow_unicode=False — and also `\x85`, ` `, ` `, `﻿` are special)

- `leadingSpace`/`trailingSpace`, `leadingBreak`/`trailingBreak` = starts/ends with space / `\n`

## File 2: /output/lib/yaml_scalar.mjs

Imports nothing external; may import from './yaml_common.mjs'. Must export:

### `resolvePlainScalar(text) -> IR scalar`
